t: This is connected to the School of Philosophy and Economic Science, also called the School of Practical Philosophy and legally named the School of Economic Science. It is a worldwide organisation based in London that offers non-academic courses for adults, mainly drawing on Advaita Vedanta. It began when the politician Andrew MacLaren founded the School of Economic Science to campaign for land value taxation. His son, Leon MacLaren, is also named as a founder. The organisation has a history of criminal child abuse in its two associated schools from the 1970s, and has been described as a cult by several former members.
